monday.later: Evening gym: Hack Squat · Negative Pull-ups · Leg Extension · Chest-Supported Row · 45° Back Extension · Zone 2 (50 min)

steps.title: Bike + hack-squat warm-up
steps.details: Easy bike ~3 min plus 2 progressively heavier ramp sets; do not rush into working load.

steps.title: Hack Squat
steps.details: 3 × 8–12 · 2–3 RIR · lower 2–3 sec · rest ~90–120 sec · comfortable pain-free knee/hip depth.

steps.title: Negative Pull-Ups
steps.details: 3 × 3–5 controlled lowers, each 4–6 sec. Keep shoulders comfortable.

steps.title: 45° Back Extension
steps.details: 2 × 10–15 · hip-hinge emphasis, controlled comfortable low-back position.

steps.title: Zone 2 cardio
steps.details: Bike or StairMaster; steady conversational intensity.

steps.title: Equipment transitions
steps.details: Move calmly between stations; breathe and set up the next station.

thursday.later: Evening gym: Pull-ups · Leg Press · Supported Short-Stance Split Squat · Leg Extension · Seated Hamstring Curl · cardio (50 min)

steps.title: Bike + leg-press ramp sets
steps.details: Easy bike and gradual leg-press warm-up; no fatiguing mobility circuit.

steps.title: Pull-Ups / Assisted Pull-Ups
steps.details: 3 × 4–8 clean reps · ~2–3 RIR · full controlled range.

steps.title: Leg Press
steps.details: 3 × 10–15 · knee-friendly depth, comfortable feet placement, full-foot pressure, 2–3 RIR.

steps.title: Supported Short-Stance Split Squat
steps.details: 2 × 8–10 per leg · start left, match reps right · front knee travels forward comfortably · 2–3 sec lower.

steps.title: Seated Hamstring Curl
steps.details: 2 × 10–15 · smooth full pain-free range; avoid back movement.

steps.title: Cardio
steps.details: Easy/moderate bike; if time permits elsewhere, supplement with Sunday swim or walking.

steps.title: Equipment transitions
steps.details: Switch machines and set equipment safely.
